changes: The sequencer now records the velocity as played; V.SNS applies to what plays, live or from the sequencer, and can be changed afterwards.
VEL as a modulation source follows every note the track plays, sequencer trigs included, and stays when another track is selected.
MIDI tracks: V.SNS applies to the notes they send, live or from the sequencer.
Under the hood: the velocity hook moved from the note router to the render's note store (audio) and the MIDI tracks' note output.
Pushing the knob whose destination list is open closes the list, as on the stock pages.
Depths (M.DEP, V.DEP, A.DEP) are as fine as the LFO page's DEP: -64.00 to +64.00.
FUNC + turn now jumps between useful values, as FUNC + TUNE jumps octaves: depths in 16s, BEND 1/2/3/5/7/12, V.SNS in 25 %, destinations page by page, CCs in tens.
Depths start at 0; V.SNS at 100 %.
SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU, MW THRU removed: each track's own switches do the job, and the mod works from power-on without ticking anything.
Known issue: settings are not saved.
The EXPRESSION page now looks like the stock FLTR and LFO pages: eight knob cells under the TRIG page's header, track box and LEV meter.
Knobs use the firmware's own acceleration, as the stock pages do; FUNC + turn puts a cell back to its default.
Turning MW, VEL or AT opens a destination list like the LFO page's DEST.
New: VEL as a modulation source (VEL DEST, V.DEP) on audio tracks.
New: V.SNS per track: how much the played velocity counts, for the sound and for what is recorded (100 % as played, 0 % every note full).
Fixed: LFO destinations (speed, multiplier, fade, phase, depth) now work; they are added before the LFO stage. FLTR slot 37, which the engine never reads, is no longer offered.
Known issue: settings are not saved. Not yet tested on a unit beyond 0.4.
New: the TRIG page's second page (tap TRIG on the TRIG page) holds each track's own settings.
Audio tracks: BEND RANGE, MW DEST, MW AMOUNT, AT DEST and AT AMOUNT per track, on knobs A-E.
MIDI tracks: PITCH BEND, AFTERTOUCH and MOD WHEEL on or off per track; MW AS and AT AS send the wheel or the pressure on a CC of your choice.
SETTINGS keeps only PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU.
Not built together with Digi Perform, which opens its page with the same gesture.
Known issue: the per-track settings are not saved; they return to their defaults at power-on. Not yet tested on a unit.
Audio tracks: pitch bend moves the track's pitch by up to PB RANGE semitones (default 2).
MW DEST and AT DEST send the mod wheel and aftertouch to a parameter of the track's sound, by MW AMT and AT AMT.
Everything adds to the track's own value and LFOs, within the parameter's range; changing track stops it.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
Pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel now add to the MIDI track's own value (its knob, parameter locks and LFO), capped to the MIDI limits.
A held bend no longer jumps back when the track sends its own value.
Selecting another track gives the previous synth back the track's own values; the new track follows only when you next move a control.
Unticking a row gives the track its own value back.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1. SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU pass pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel from MIDI IN to the synth a MIDI track plays.
They follow the notes: the AUTO CHANNEL to the active MIDI track, a TRACK CHANNEL to that track, sent on the track's CHAN.
Sequencer notes and controls go out first. DIN MIDI OUT only. Unticked, MIDI is stock.
The settings are not saved and start unticked at every power-on.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
